tree.name: #tree# tree
tree.appearance: A lone {self.name} stands here, older than anyone living.
tree.description: Its bark is deeply furrowed and patched with lichen. The lowest branches are just out of reach.

touch: The bark is rough and cool beneath your palm.

bird_nest.name: bird's nest
bird_nest.appearance: A bird's nest is wedged in a fork of the branches.
bird_nest.description: A neat cup of twigs and moss.

speckled_egg.name: speckled egg
speckled_egg.description: A small blue egg flecked with brown.

tree_hollow.name: hollow
tree_hollow.description: A dark hollow in the trunk, big enough to put an arm into.

stream.name: stream
stream.appearance: A clear stream runs over pebbles, chattering to itself.
stream.description: The water is cold and clear. Small fish dart between the stones.

drink: You cup your hands and drink. The water is icy and sweet.
listen: The stream chatters endlessly over its stones.

fallen_log.name: fallen log
fallen_log.appearance: A fallen log lies rotting across the way, furred with moss.
fallen_log.description: The log is soft with rot and crawling with beetles. Something might be hidden beneath it.

push: You heave at the log. It shifts a little, releasing a smell of damp earth.

boulder.name: #color# boulder
boulder.appearance: A great boulder squats beside the way, as if dropped by a giant.
boulder.description: Weathered smooth on top, and deeply undercut at the base where shadows pool.

push: You push against the boulder. It does not notice.

berry_bush.name: #berry# bush
berry_bush.appearance: A tangled {self.name} grows at the edge of the path.
berry_bush.description: Thorny stems arch in every direction.

wild_berries.name: handful of berries
wild_berries.description: A handful of ripe berries, staining your fingers purple.

wildflowers.name: wildflowers
wildflowers.description: Bees bumble lazily from bloom to bloom.

take: You pick a few flowers, then let them fall; they'd only wilt.

standing_stone.name: standing stone
standing_stone.appearance: A standing stone leans at an angle, carved with spirals.
standing_stone.description: The spirals have been worn almost smooth by centuries of rain. Lichen fills the grooves.

props.text: The spirals seem to turn as you trace them with your eyes. You blink and they are still.

touch: The stone is strangely warm, as if it has been sitting in the sun all day. It hasn't.

milestone.name: milestone
milestone.appearance: A squat milestone stands at the roadside.
milestone.description: Old letters are carved into its face.

signpost.name: signpost
signpost.appearance: A crooked signpost points in several directions at once.
signpost.description: Weathered arms point every which way.

props.text: The arms read: "#place_name#", "#place_name#" and, half broken off, "#place_name#".

scarecrow.name: scarecrow
scarecrow.appearance: A scarecrow in a battered hat stands guard over a field.
scarecrow.description: Its sackcloth face has a stitched smile. One straw hand seems to be pointing somewhere.

battered_hat.name: battered hat
battered_hat.description: A wide-brimmed straw hat with a hole in the crown. It still keeps the rain off. Mostly.

reeds.name: reeds
reeds.appearance: Tall reeds rattle in the wind.
reeds.description: Dense reed beds, taller than you are. Things could hide in there.

will_o_wisp.name: flickering light
will_o_wisp.appearance: A pale light bobs above the water some way off.
will_o_wisp.description: It drifts away whenever you look straight at it.

take: You reach out. The light is always a little further away than it seemed.

campfire_remains.name: old campfire
campfire_remains.appearance: A ring of blackened stones marks where someone camped.
campfire_remains.description: The ashes are cold. Whoever was here left in a hurry; the ground is churned.

mushrooms.name: cluster of mushrooms
mushrooms.appearance: A cluster of pale mushrooms sprouts from the leaf litter.
mushrooms.description: Pale caps with brownish gills. You think they're the edible kind.

apple.name: windfall apple
apple.description: A slightly bruised but perfectly good apple.

stale_bread.name: heel of bread

props.taste: Hard enough to break a tooth, but it fills you.

stale_bread.description: Stale bread, wrapped in a scrap of cloth.

copper_coins.name: handful of copper coins
copper_coins.description: Worn copper coins, stamped with the faces of forgotten kings. {self.value} of them.

tinderbox.name: tinderbox
tinderbox.description: A small tin with flint, steel and dry tinder. Useful for lighting things.

do: You strike a spark and {second} catches.
You strike a few sparks. They die on the ground.

torn_map.name: torn map
torn_map.description: Half of a map, torn diagonally. A dotted line ends at an X.

props.text: Beside the X someone has written: "#place_name#. Under the #color# stone."

walking_stick.name: #tree#wood walking stick
walking_stick.description: A sturdy stick, worn smooth where countless hands have gripped it.

trinket.name: #trinket#
trinket.description: A small lost thing. Someone, somewhere, probably misses it.

lost_locket.name: silver locket
lost_locket.description: A tarnished silver locket on a broken chain. It opens to show a faded portrait.

wild_deer.name: red deer
wild_deer.appearance: A red deer lifts its head and watches you, ears flicking.
wild_deer.description: Sleek and wary, ready to bolt.

take: The deer bounds away a few paces and resumes watching you.
talk: The deer is unimpressed by your conversation.

wanderer_traveller.name: #wanderer_name#
wanderer_traveller.appearance: {self.Name}, a traveller, rests here by the wayside.
wanderer_traveller.description: Road-dusty and weather-browned, with a pack slung over one shoulder and sharp, curious eyes.

do: {self.Name} accepts it gratefully. "Kind of you. Here, take this for your trouble."

wanderer_pilgrim.name: pilgrim
wanderer_pilgrim.appearance: A grey-robed pilgrim sits on a stone here, rubbing their tired feet.
wanderer_pilgrim.description: Their robe is patched and their staff hung with little lead badges from distant shrines.
